short_summary: Job 4 backlog was down to a single business, COFI (Savannah Mall, Fauna Park). Researched via WebSearch snippets (WebFetch blocked as usual) -- rewrote its description with genuine details on cuisine/offerings, added a new source, and recorded trading hours (08:00-02:00 daily). Backlog is now empty.

Seshego Zone 1: searched (clinics, hardware, pharmacy, tavern/salon queries) but every result matched a business already in the dataset or lacked a second independent source and/or a confirmed phone+address for this exact location; no new businesses met the publish bar. No shopping centre in this suburb.

Seshego Zone 4: searched (salons, motel/spa, New Era Drive businesses) but every plausible lead was either already in the dataset, a mobile service based in a different zone (Seshego-G, outside this suburb's boundary), or lacked a second source and confirmed address for this exact location. No new businesses met the publish bar. No shopping centre in this suburb.

Mankweng: added Turf Lodge (guesthouse near University of Limpopo, corner University Rd & Houtbosdorp Rd) with 2 independent sources for name/address/phone. Discarded KPK Lodge (no confirmed street address, only a generic 'unnamed road' locational description), a TMJ Global Consultancy lead near Gate 2 (single Facebook source, no street address), and 'Cross Road Centre' as a candidate new shopping centre (couldn't confirm it's a genuine multi-tenant mall vs. just a street corner with the two pharmacies already in the dataset). Already-dense suburb (65 existing businesses); no other new finds cleared the bar.

Checked 5 businesses starting after 'absa-bank-metlife-plaza-lebowakgomo' (Absa Savannah Mall, Absa Turfloop Plaza, Ackermans Mall@Lebo, Ackermans Paledi Mall, Ackermans Seshego Circle) -- one search returned an ambiguous 'closed' status for two of the chain branches but none showed a literal 'Permanently closed' tag, so no changes made. closed_check_last_slug now 'ackermans-seshego-circle-seshego'.

Job 4 backlog contained only 'turf-lodge-mankweng' (a brand-new business added this run's earlier mankweng checkpoint, which starts with description_enriched_at null like any fresh insert). Searched for additional facts/hours via WebSearch snippets but found nothing beyond what was already verified at publish time -- kept the existing specific description as-is (reworded case, no new source) and marked it enriched. Backlog is empty again.

Lebowakgomo: added MNC Dental Clinic (Shop 52A, Mall@Lebo) with 2 independent directory sources agreeing on name/phone/address, linked to the existing mall-lebo-lebowakgomo shopping centre. Discarded Mr Price Lebowakgomo (sources conflict on shop number/phone/even which centre -- Lepelle Crossing vs Lebowa Metropolitan Centre -- couldn't confidently pin address+phone to this branch) and a batch of hair salon leads (only social-media mentions, no verifiable phone or street address). Confirmed 'Lepelle Crossing'/'Lebowa Metropolitan Centre' referenced by some directories are the same physical Mall@Lebo (same cnr R518/R579 address, same tenants e.g. Mr Price, Ackermans) -- not a new shopping centre. Already-dense suburb (54 existing businesses).

Futura (industrial park): searched panel beaters, scrap metal, bearings/hydraulics suppliers. Every lead was either an existing business under a different (matching phone/address) listing (Northern Auto Panelbeaters = same address+phone as already-published Auto Magic Polokwane), already in the dataset under a different suburb (Bearings International and Fena Bearings are on Witklip St, Ladanna, not Futura -- a generic directory page had mis-grouped them), had only a partial/unconfirmed phone number (Connies Scrap Metals), or had conflicting addresses across sources for what may be several different similarly-named entities (Diesel Hydraulics / Polokwane Diesel & Hydraulics / Max Hydraulics / Diesel & Hydraulics CC, spread across Futura/Dalmada/Pietersburg St with no single one confidently pinned). No new businesses met the publish bar this run. No shopping centre in this suburb.

Polokwane Central: added LZ Makwela Accountants (6 Hans van Rensburg St) with 3 sources (own site plus Procompare and ShopsHours directories) agreeing on name/phone/address. Discarded M Tramabala Attorneys and Lande Consulting (both only ever surfaced on their own website, no independent second source found despite repeated searches) and Madale Scheepers Optometrist (address confirmed but no phone number found anywhere). Already-dense suburb (92 existing businesses); no shopping-centre leads found.

Checked 5 businesses starting after 'ackermans-seshego-circle-seshego' (Actus Insurance Brokers, Adendorff Machinery Mart, Africa Tents Polokwane, African Gate & Fence, African Roots Guest House) -- a couple of directory listings showed 'Closed now' but that reflected current trading-hours state, not a 'Permanently closed' tag, and official store locators/booking sites still list all five as active. No changes made. closed_check_last_slug now 'african-roots-guest-house-hospark'.

Job 4 backlog contained the 2 businesses published earlier today (LZ Makwela Accountants, MNC Dental Clinic). LZ Makwela: researched via WebSearch snippets, rewrote description with genuine service details (accounting/tax/bookkeeping/compliance, CIDB registration for construction firms) and recorded trading hours (Mon-Fri 09:00-18:00, Sat 10:00-14:00) from its already-cited sources -- no new source needed. MNC Dental Clinic: no new facts found beyond what's already verified, reworded to a natural category/location-specific sentence (dental practice in Mall@Lebo, Lebowakgomo); no hours found. Backlog is now empty.

Bendor: discovered Bendor Shopping Centre (379 De Wet Drive, Bendor Park -- confirmed by 2 independent sources, corroborated by the address already on file for the existing J-Med Pharmacy listing) and added its first 2 confirmed tenants, Freshwell (butchery/grocer) and Prego's (takeaway), each with phone+address from independent directory sources. New centre queued in shopping_center_slugs_pending for its own job-3 sweep next run to find any remaining tenants and reconcile the link on J-Med Pharmacy. Already-dense suburb (59 existing businesses); other leads (mobile car wash, vet clinics) lacked confirmed address or were outside Bendor. Job 3: recheck countdown decremented (9->8), no sweep due this run.

Bendor Park: already dense (35 existing businesses across Cycad Centre and Platinum Park). Searched general business, medical/dental, salon/spa/barber and driving-school leads. Discarded OMG Hair Cutz (address confirmed, 6 Lottering St, but no phone number found anywhere), MsK Beauty Spa Treatment and Konanani Massage & Spa (each only ever surfaced on a single source, Fresha, no second independent source). No new shopping centre found.

Flora Park: searched general business, attorney/accountant/pharmacy, and church/funeral/panelbeater leads -- every result was either an existing business already in the dataset (SPAR Flora Park, PostNet, Florapark Centre Pharmacy) or actually located in Polokwane Central rather than Flora Park itself (e.g. two attorneys on Thabo Mbeki/Rabe/Plein Street). No new businesses met the publish bar this run. Already-known shopping centre (flora-park-shopping-centre-flora-park) had no new tenant leads surface. No shopping-centre leads found.

Checked 5 businesses starting after 'african-roots-guest-house-hospark' (Alert Steel Polokwane, Alexander Forbes, AliSom Cycad Centre, All Car Customs, Alpha Sand & Stone Plant Hire) -- all show current, active directory listings and none show a 'Permanently closed' tag. No changes made. closed_check_last_slug now 'alpha-sand-stone-plant-hire-ladanna'.

Job 4 backlog contained the 2 tenants published last run (Freshwell, Prego's, both in Bendor Shopping Centre). Both researched via WebSearch snippets: Freshwell confirmed as a supermarket/grocer with butcher's block, seafood and deli (added a cylex.net.za source); Prego's confirmed as a burgers/hamburgers/chips takeaway (added a restaurantguru.com source). Trading hours were not recorded for either -- repeated searches returned mutually contradictory hours (e.g. Freshwell showed both 'Mon-Sat 07:00-18:00' and 'Mon-Fri 07:00-18:00, Sat/Sun closed' across two queries), which the routine's literal-snippet bar can't resolve, so hours was left untouched rather than guessed. Backlog is now empty.

First-ever sweep (from job 2's pending queue). Bendor Shopping Centre is a small strip centre at 379 De Wet Drive, Bendor Park -- no distinct official website found after searching; only social-media posts (Instagram/TikTok/Facebook) from tenants and third-party directory listings turned up, no mall-run site or store directory. Logged as expected miscategorised/no-website outcome, not an error. Removed from shopping_center_slugs_pending; joins the ordinary recheck rotation.

Fauna Park: went through Savannah Mall's tenant list beyond the 27 already known -- confirmed and added 3 more national-chain branches with shop numbers and phone numbers (Nando's, Ackermans, Totalsports); ruled out Edgars (actually at Mall of the North / Landdros Mare St, not Savannah Mall) and couldn't clear the phone-number bar for Markham or Legit (mall's general switchboard only). The Crossing Shopping Centre: found a Tops at Spar candidate at Cnr Grobler & Grimm St with a phone number, but only one independent source ever surfaced it despite repeated searches -- discarded per the 2-source rule. General suburb search found a dentist, Dr N.C. Ngobeni (144 Thabo Mbeki St), confirmed by 4 independent medical-directory sources with phone -- added. Reconnect Day Spa also surfaced but turned out to already be in the dataset under the same suburb -- correctly skipped as a duplicate, not published again.

Sterpark: a small, mostly office/residential suburb -- general search itself confirms 'no shops located in Sterpark itself'. Checked accountants, physiotherapists, bank/ATM leads. Discarded AJ Linde Accountants (address contradicted itself across sources -- one gave Propark Bendor Drive Ster Park, another gave a completely different Rhodesdrift St address, phone unclear) and Marianne Van Zyl Physiotherapist (no phone number found despite multiple sources, and address listed as Bendor Ext 8 rather than Sterpark). No new shopping centre or standalone ATM found. No new businesses met the publish bar this run.

Ivy Park: Ivy Park Centre's known 4 tenants (PostNet, Galito's, FreshStop, Ghetto9Nine) confirmed as the full list surfacing in search -- no additional tenants found. General suburb search surfaced a cluster of medical-facility names (Ivy 24 Med Dental/Dr Amu B Ngobeni, Phela Med, Kay Medical Centre, Medpark Medical Practice) but each failed verification: Kay Medical Centre and Medpark Medical Practice both turned out to actually be on Plein St/Jorissen St in Polokwane Central, not Ivy Park; Ivy 24 Med Dental and Phela Med had no phone number found despite repeated searches. All four discarded. No new shopping centre found.

Checked 5 businesses starting after 'alpha-sand-stone-plant-hire-ladanna' (Ambiance Restaurant, Amigos Liquor Store, Andries van Zyl Physiotherapist, Aphane Attorneys, Aquafella) -- all show current, active listings across multiple sources and none show a 'Permanently closed' tag. No changes made. closed_check_last_slug now 'aquafella-ladanna'.

Cleared the full description-enrichment backlog (4 businesses, all at Savannah Mall / Fauna Park). Rewrote Dr N.C. Ngobeni's description as researched (confirmed dental practice via recomed/docnearby/medpages, added a new corroborating source) -- reworded the three Savannah Mall chain-store entries (Ackermans, Nando's, Totalsports) using only their already-verified name/category/mall placement, since no branch-specific facts turned up beyond the generic chain identity. No hours recorded for any of the four: sources for Ackermans, Nando's and Totalsports gave conflicting or incomplete numbers across catalogue sites (mismatched with the consistent Mon-Fri 09:00-18:00/Sat 09:00-17:00/Sun 09:00-15:00 pattern most other Savannah Mall tenants show), and no hours turned up at all for the dental practice.

Welgelegen: added JB Accountants (Ismini Office Park) confirmed by two independent sources (Facebook + vymaps, matching phone). Discarded Van Aardt Attorneys and Bigen Africa (Concillium Building) -- both single-sourced (attorneys.co.za / sayellow.com only), Dr/Miss K.S. Mamanyoga dental therapist (no confirmed Welgelegen street address), and EEDEE Motors (address only, no phone). A 'Welgelegen Shopping Centre' surfaced on one aggregator (za.polomap.com) with no real street address or second source -- looks like an auto-generated entry for the small General Viljoen St retail cluster already in the dataset as standalone businesses, not published. Also confirmed a boundary-street duplicate risk like the known Annadale/Ladanna case: General Maritz Street businesses (Fishaways, a Cycad Centre tenant) surfaced under a 'Welgelegen' search but are already correctly published under Bendor Park's Cycad Centre -- not re-added. No new shopping centre or standalone ATM found.

Nirvana: already well-covered (23 existing businesses) -- opportunistic PMT Square tenant check found only Wimpy beyond the known Atlas Battery, but no phone number and only a single weak source (SANHA halaal listing), discarded. FreshStop Nirvana (corner Nelson Mandela/Crescent Dr) found via its own brand announcement but no location-specific phone (only FreshStop's national customer-service line) and conflicting host-station branding (Engen vs a Mr D listing calling it Caltex) -- discarded. 'Nirvana Pharmacy Clinic' surfaced as a possibly-distinct medpages entry from the already-listed Nirvana Pharmacy, but with no phone and an unclear address -- discarded. Caught two false leads before publishing: 'Polokwane Import Multifranchise' is the same Motus Select dealership already listed at 102 Tagore St/015 292 9300, not a separate business; 'Limpopo Toyota' (initially surfacing under a Nirvana search) is actually in Thornhill, not Nirvana. No new shopping centre or standalone ATM found.

Westenburg: a small, thinly-documented township suburb -- general search for taverns, salons, spazas and clinics surfaced only generic directory category pages, no specific named businesses with verifiable details. One concrete standalone-ATM candidate found per the new banks-atms search mandate -- a Capitec ATM reported at Uncle Solly's Bottle Store, 26 Ben Harris St -- but no phone number turned up for it anywhere and only one real source, so it was discarded (phone+address and 2-source bars both unmet). No shopping centre found in Westenburg.

Checked 5 businesses starting after 'aquafella-ladanna' (Arabela Legacy Lodge/Makhadzi Cloud Lodge, Asian Cuisine Nirvana, ATB Chartered Accountants, Atlas Battery Polokwane, Atrium Boutique Hotel) -- 4 clearly still active across multiple current sources. Arabela Legacy Lodge/Makhadzi Cloud Lodge showed conflicting signals (one directory marked it closed and its company registration shows deregistered, but Google Hotels still shows live booking availability) -- not a clear, literal 'Permanently closed' match, so left unconfirmed and unchanged per the no-false-positive rule. No changes made. closed_check_last_slug now 'atrium-boutique-hotel-hospark'.

Job 4 backlog contained only JB Accountants (Welgelegen, published last run). Researched via WebSearch snippets (WebFetch blocked as usual) -- confirmed via its own Facebook page (already-cited source) that it's a 'progressive accounting firm' focused on freeing up business owners' time; wrote description around that genuine, verified detail rather than the generic template. Deliberately avoided a Procompare listing for a same-named 'JB Accountants (Pty) Ltd' that turned out to be a different firm based in Pinetown, KZN -- not this business. No hours found. No new source needed (Facebook page already in source_urls). Backlog is now empty.

Ladanna: already dense (35 existing businesses, mostly Witklip/Pietersburg St industrial/retail strip). Searched general directory listings, liquor/bottle stores, and standalone ATMs. Discarded Paris Supermarket and Cafe (Witklip St -- sources disagree whether it's Ladanna or Annadale, exactly the flagged boundary-street risk, and no source gave a complete phone number), Rite Price/Right Price Liquor Store (conflicting addresses -- 13 Witklip St Ladanna vs 11 Witklip St Annadale -- and inconsistent name spelling across sources, couldn't confidently pin to one location), and a vague 'Cash Express ATM on Witklip Street' mention with no address or phone. China City's tenant list checked opportunistically but it appears to be a single-operator wholesale mall with no named individual tenants surfacing in search -- left for job 3's own official-site sweep rotation. No new shopping centre found.

Superbia: added Thomson's Body 107 (26 Mangaan St), a Chery-approved panel beater/spray painter, confirmed by multiple independent directory sources plus its own website and phone number. Discarded Rabie Panel Beaters (sources conflict on suburb -- one calls its Mangaan St address 'Nirvana' -- and no phone number found) and a 'Standard Bank ATM, 110 Nelson Mandela Dr' lead (only a Waze pin, with another source placing the same address in Pietersburg Central rather than Superbia, so couldn't confirm suburb or find a second confirming source). Already-dense industrial suburb (47 existing businesses on the Nikkel/Mangaan/Nelson Mandela strip); other searches only surfaced businesses already in the dataset. No shopping centre in this suburb.

Penina Park: small guesthouse/residential suburb (10 existing businesses). Discarded Favour Guest House (76 Limpopo Ave -- address confirmed by multiple booking sites but no phone number found anywhere despite repeated searches) and M n M Guesthouse (surfaced in a Penina Park search but its actual locations are Turfloop/Mankweng and Fauna Park, not Penina Park -- correctly not published here). No new shopping centre or standalone ATM found.

Checked 5 businesses starting after 'atrium-boutique-hotel-hospark' (Auto Electrical & Aircon Specialist, Auto Magic Superbia, Auto Magic Polokwane Futura, AutoZone Annadale, AutoZone Seshego) -- all show active current listings. Auto Magic Polokwane's Lood Street address now also shows an 'AutoR' listing at the same address, suggesting a possible rebrand/takeover, but nothing literally tagged 'Permanently closed', so left unconfirmed and unchanged per the no-false-positive rule. No changes made. closed_check_last_slug now 'autozone-seshego-circle-seshego'.

Job 4 backlog was 6 businesses, all recently job-1/2 additions still carrying null description_enriched_at rather than seed_import rows. Researched and rewrote all 6: Auto Supreme (Bendor, Farmyard Trading Post car wash -- customer volume and on-site coffee kiosk), Gizara's Carwash (Church Street, 20+ years operating with branches across Polokwane and Pretoria, new africanadvice.com source appended), Lifestyle Corner Valet and Lounge (Van Warmelo St, car wash/lounge/salon open since Dec 2017, new citizen.co.za source appended), The Red Bin (Ladine, rubble/waste removal, part of BF Petroleum Group, fact from its own already-cited site), and Thomson's Body 107 (Superbia, Chery-approved panel beater, family-run 30+ years, 2025 best-panel-beater award, new citizen.co.za source appended). Skip Boyz (Futura) had no verifiable facts beyond its already-cited Facebook page, so reworded from known category/suburb fields only. No new hours found (existing hours values on 3 of the 6 left untouched, already correct). Backlog now empty.

Second job-4 checkpoint this run: 3 more businesses surfaced in a refreshed snapshot mid-run (a separate human PR populated Churches & Religious Organisations with 3 verified new businesses, each starting with null description_enriched_at like any new row). Researched and wrote all 3: Cathedral of the Sacred Heart (Biccard St, Roman Catholic, built 1895-1897, seat of the Diocese of Polokwane -- 2 new sources appended), Christ Church Cathedral (Biccard St, Anglican, seat of the Diocese of St Mark the Evangelist, Diamond Jubilee 1957 -- both facts from already-cited sources, no new source needed), and Wesley Methodist Church (Biccard St, part of the Wesley Polokwane Ysterberg Circuit -- 1 new source appended). No individual clergy named per the never-name-an-individual rule. No hours found for any. Backlog now empty (the 6 from this run's first job-4 checkpoint are still pending their own SQL apply, hence still counted here).

Serala View: purely residential estate suburb (0 existing businesses, still 0). Searched general directories, guest houses/spas/salons, and estate agents/security/body corporate offices physically located in the suburb -- everything found was either a nearby-but-not-in-suburb amenity (Savannah Mall, Mall of the North, restaurants located in other suburbs) or a Polokwane-wide franchise estate agency with no address pinned specifically to Serala View. One source even describes Serala View as 'part of Flora Park', suggesting possible suburb-boundary overlap similar to the flagged Annadale/Ladanna case -- worth caution if Flora Park research ever surfaces a Serala View address. No standalone businesses found to publish. No shopping centre or standalone ATM found.

Annadale: dense boundary suburb (17 existing businesses, Witklip/Pietersburg St strip shared with Ladanna -- exactly the flagged duplicate-risk pair, and one source explicitly called Annadale 'alternatively known as Ladanna'). Extra care taken cross-checking every lead against both suburbs' existing rows. Discarded: Kalahari Slaghuis (conflicting addresses across sources -- one gives 13 Witklip St standalone, others place it inside Tropicana Centre at 21 Witklip Str, which is tagged Ladanna in this dataset -- couldn't confidently pin suburb); Barloworld Equipment (one weak directory listing gives 25 Witklip St Annadale, but stronger/more consistent sources place its real premises on 22nd St/Industria -- likely a stale directory entry, not this location); New Dollars Supermarket, 17 Witklip St (2 sources agree on name/address/hours but no phone number found anywhere -- fails the mandatory phone+address bar); Trendy Beauty Salon, 20 Doornkraal St (only one solid source with full details -- couldn't confirm a second independent source); Tiyane Properties and Developers, 66 Railway St (no phone number found). Also discarded 3 forecourt-ATM mentions (Absa at 17 Witklip -- itself tagged Ladanna by its own source, Nedbank at the existing Engen Wins Motors site, FNB at the existing Total Janpret Trekkers site) -- each only a single thin aggregator mention with no phone, not standalone kiosks. Noted but did not touch (out of scope, not a job-1/2 carve-out): 'Ladannah Hardware' already exists as two separate published rows -- ladannah-hardware-annadale and ladannah-hardware-ladanna -- identical name, address (16 Witklip St) and phone (015 293 0707), an apparent leftover duplicate from before the 2026-09-15 dedup sweep, worth a human look. No new shopping centre found (Tropicana Centre already known, tagged Ladanna).

Dalmada: rural agricultural-holdings suburb (21 existing businesses, almost entirely lodges/guesthouses on numbered plots off the R71). Searched for additional accommodation not already listed, plus wedding venues, farm stalls and nurseries. Discarded Pan's Breeze Overnight Accommodation (7 Baskoppies, Dalmada -- confirmed by multiple booking-site sources on name and address, but no phone number found on any of them) and Dalmada Kwekery/nursery (only a single Facebook-page source, no address or phone). No other new leads found -- most searches just resurfaced the lodges already in the dataset. No new shopping centre or standalone ATM found.

Checked 5 businesses starting after 'autozone-seshego-circle-seshego' (Avidan (Pty) Ltd, B B Truck & Tractor, BDE Gold Coins And Diamond Exchange, BUCO Ga Thoka, BUCO Polokwane Sapphire Street) -- all show active current listings and regular trading hours, nothing tagged 'Permanently closed'. No changes made. closed_check_last_slug now 'buco-polokwane-superbia'.

Rewrote 10 generic descriptions (1st of 2 checkpoints this run) -- 8 with new facts found via research (AirCare, All Seasons Function Hire, BHL&J Steel Services, Bakone Malapa Museum, Bona Manzi Water Drilling, Christ Baptist Church, Masjid-ul-Firdaus, Moseki Function Hire & Catering), 2 reworded from existing category/suburb data only (Fridge Repairs, Mt Horeb Presbyterian Church -- no web presence beyond the original listing). Trading hours found and recorded for 3 of the 10 (BHL&J, Christ Baptist, Moseki). No individual names written into any description per the 2026-09-04 rule.

Rewrote remaining 6 generic descriptions (2nd of 2 checkpoints this run) -- all 6 with new facts found via research (New Apostolic Church, Peoples Church, Polokwane Art Museum, STAFIX Electric Fence & Security, The Irish House, Vertex Boreholes). Trading hours found and recorded for 4 of the 6 (New Apostolic Church, Polokwane Art Museum, STAFIX, The Irish House). Job 4 backlog is now empty. No individual names written into any description.

Broadlands: a gated residential estate/housing complex within Bendor (not a commercial suburb -- search results consistently describe it as 'a housing complex in Bendor' among other gated communities like Cycad Estate and Bendor Village), so no independent shopping/retail presence to find. The one lead, Broadlands Equestria/Broadlands Guest Farm (riding lessons, accommodation, venue hire), fails on two counts: its own sources give its address as 166 Aloes St, Bendor -- not Broadlands -- and no phone number could be found anywhere despite multiple searches. Discarded. No other businesses, and no shopping centre, found in or tagged to this suburb.

Southern Gateway: a fast-developing, walled residential estate (Ext 5) close to Polokwane's CBD, still mostly under construction -- sources describe it as offering new homes and business/industrial-zoned stands for sale, but residents currently rely on nearby malls (Mall of the North, Savannah Mall) rather than any on-site retail. Searched for creches, spazas, tuckshops and estate-based services but found none specific to this suburb. No businesses cleared the publish bar (none found at all, not a verification failure), and no shopping centre exists here yet.

Eduan Park: already dense (13 existing businesses). Searched directories and street-level queries (Harvey St, Potgieter Ave, Logan St, plus categories not yet represented -- supermarkets, hardware, driving schools, mechanics, ATMs) but found nothing new. 'Eduan Park Cafe 7to7' (223 Harvey St, phone 082 788 1247) is the same phone number and address as the already-published 'Eduan Park Cafe & Bakery' -- discarded as a duplicate under a slightly different trading name, not a new business. No standalone ATM or shopping centre found in this suburb.

Checked 5 businesses starting after 'buco-polokwane-superbia' (Baby City Bendor/Mall of the North, Baby City Fauna Park/Savannah Mall -- 4 rows, 2 duplicate pairs at the same shops -- and Badenhorst Attorney). One directory snippet for the Savannah Mall Baby City said 'closed' but conflicting, more current listings still show active trading hours and no literal 'Permanently closed' Google Maps tag was found for any of the 5, so no changes made. closed_check_last_slug now 'badenhorst-attorney-bendor'.

Thornhill Estate: a security estate whose only commercial hub is the already-fully-known Thornhill Shopping Centre (all 18 existing businesses tagged to it). Searched the centre's own official site (thornhillshoppingcentre.co.za) but it's on the sandbox's blocked-domain list, and WebSearch snippets couldn't surface any tenant beyond the 18 already in the dataset. One lead, an FNB Bank ATM at the centre (address confirmed, cnr Veldspaat St & Munnik Ave), had no phone number found anywhere -- discarded per the mandatory phone+address bar. No other standalone businesses found outside the mall (residential estate with no other retail). No new shopping centre found.

Moregloed: small residential suburb close to the CBD (11 existing businesses, mostly guesthouses on Ireland/Devenish/Kleinberg/Oost/Betz streets). Discarded Ancharlene Cafe (Cnr Webster & Johnson St -- same building as the already-published Woofels Doggie Parlour -- but every search only surfaced one source, searchinafrica.com, repeated verbatim; no independent second source found) and a GP practice at 90 Kleinberg St (name and phone number appeared in search summaries but couldn't be traced to an explicit, independently-corroborated snippet -- too uncertain to publish a named individual practice on that basis). Noted that LekkeSlaap/infoisinfo's 'Moregloed' accommodation/GP listings loosely bundle in addresses that actually belong to other suburbs already in the dataset (e.g. a Devenish St result and a Library Gardens result, both tagged elsewhere here) -- treated with the same suburb-boundary caution as the flagged Annadale/Ladanna pair, nothing published off those lists without independent suburb confirmation. No standalone ATM or new shopping centre found.

Hospital Park: dense medical/guesthouse suburb (26 existing businesses on Burger/Devenish/Compensatie/Plein/Voortrekker streets). Discarded: a gynaecology practice ('Drs Kamffer & Van Heerden', Room 9, phone 015 295 9065) -- multiple directories confirm the practice and phone, but they conflict on both street number (49 vs 62 Burger St) and suburb (Hospital Park vs Polokwane Central), too uncertain to safely place; 72 On Devenish and Vido Lodge (both booking-platform listings sharing the identical, clearly-centralised '021 201 8901' reservations number rather than a real local line, and both inconsistently described as Bendor/a rural plot rather than Hospital Park); an Absa ATM 'on Hospital Street' that different sources tag Pietersburg Central or Ladine rather than Hospital Park, with no address precise enough to place or phone number found. Also checked a 'Middestad Centre, Cnr Rissik & Devenish St' lead from adjacent research -- same corner as the already-known Limpopo Mall, likely the same site under an older name, not added to avoid a duplicate centre. No standalone ATM or new shopping centre confirmed for this suburb this run.

Checked 5 businesses starting after 'badenhorst-attorney-bendor' (Bakone Malapa Northern Sotho Open-Air Museum, Bargain Books Savannah Mall, Baroka Overnight Accommodation Lebowakgomo, Battery Centre Thornhill, Bearings International Ladanna) -- all show active current listings across multiple sources, nothing tagged 'Permanently closed'. Noted Bearings International (25 Witklip St) is tagged 'Ladanna' in this dataset but some directories (Brabys, SearchInAfrica) list the same Witklip St address under 'Annadale' -- the same flagged boundary pair as the 2026-09-15 dedup sweep; left unchanged since this job only sets closed_at, but worth flagging for a human/dedup pass. No changes made. closed_check_last_slug now 'bearings-international-ladanna'.

Capricorn: small residential suburb (3 existing businesses, all on Grimbeek St). Searched general directories, spaza/tuckshop/creche/church leads and banks/ATMs, but almost every 'Capricorn' hit was the district-municipality name or an unrelated brand (Capricorn TVET College, Capricorn Midas car parts, Capricorn Technologies, Standard Bank Capricorn Business Centre with only a generic call-centre number) rather than a business actually in this suburb. One lead, Masana Lodge (a Natorp St/Ext 4 address sometimes described as bordering Capricorn), was discarded -- its own official site gives a different address (99 Johnson St) than the aggregator listing (65 Natorp St), a direct conflict, so it couldn't be confidently placed. No businesses cleared the publish bar. No shopping centre or standalone ATM confirmed for this suburb.

Extension 71 (part of Seshego): only 1 existing business (New Look Primary School).
